confidence: medium — based on secondary reporting of Perplexity's official Sonar prompt guide, not independently re-fetched during this build session
guidance: Put the actual information need in direct, specific, query-like language rather than burying it under scene-setting or role-play.

Keep any role/persona framing minimal — Perplexity's documented architecture runs its web-search step using only the user message, and the system prompt is only applied at answer-generation time after search results are already retrieved, so persona framing cannot shape what gets searched.
avoid: Elaborate persona/role-play framing — it doesn't influence retrieval and mostly wastes words here.

Claiming the generated prompt itself can control search parameters (domain filters, recency, etc.) — those are API-level settings, not something prompt text can set, and the generated prompt must never imply otherwise.
importantLimitation: This adapter only writes prompt text for the answer-generation step. It has no ability to configure retrieval/search parameters, and must not pretend otherwise.
